members.name: MADALINA IAMANDI
members.role: Founder of MADAM Beauty By PricelessIntegrity
members.bio:
Known for her meticulous extractions and soft touch, Madalina's practice is guided strictly by safety, authenticity,  and uncompromising standards.
Originally from the scenic Black Sea coast of Romania, Madalina has dedicated her life to the art of holistic, non-invasive facial rejuvenation. Her career began in 2005 within the specialized field of balneotherapy wellness, where she mastered the foundations of body and skin restoration before bringing her unique expertise to the competitive New York beauty market.
members.training: Driven by a lifelong dream to practice in New York City, Madalina relocated and formalized her American credentials at the world-renowned Christine Valmy International School of Esthetics in 2010. Committed to lifelong learning, she continuously updates her education to master the latest innovations in non-invasive technology and dermatological facials.
members.experience: Since graduating, Madalina has partnered exclusively with elite, high-end luxury medical practices and skin clinics across Manhattan.
members.philosophy: Madalina’s signature method perfectly bridges the gap between clinical results and holistic wellness. She blends her extensive technical and clinical knowledge with a nurturing, deeply relaxing touch. Every facial is meticulously customized to be effective and result-oriented, leaving the skin noticeably rejuvenated, radiant, and structurally uplifted.
members.passion: Madalina’s love for facial therapies sparked during her early years in Europe. Today, she is inspired by the vital role she plays in her clients' long-term skincare journeys. She believes that true skin health is a partnership. By educating her clients on advanced skincare routines and collaborating with them on tailored treatments, Madalina strives to maximize their skin’s natural potential—ensuring every client walks away with a radiant complexion and a confident smile.
